common_mistakes.text: Taking the simple average of the two speeds, (4 + 6)/2 = 5 m/s, instead of weighting each speed by the time spent at it.
Using the equal-distance average-speed formula 2v1v2/(v1 + v2) = 4.8 m/s, which only applies when the two legs cover equal distances, not equal-looking legs with different times.
